# Imperium rice Arch packages. One name (or alt1|alt2) per line.
# Comments and blanks ignored. A line is satisfied if any alternative is installed.
# Installed via: paru -S --needed --noconfirm <first missing name per line>
# Floorp is handled separately (Flatpak: one.ablaze.floorp).
